items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: We have Ralph Ellison’s the recordings that he listened to

ctx.x: We moved to a new building about 2-1/2 years ago and it’s spanking new and great. We just have a large one room, but we have some great collections. We have Ralph Ellison’s the recordings that he listened to when he was writing “Invisible Man.”
